༄༅/ /thugs dam nang gi gtor bsngos gsang sngags nang gtor kun gyi don bsdus dmigs rim zhor la gsal ba'i khyad chos ting 'dzin sngags phyag rgya gyer sgo

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thugs dam nang gi gtor bsngos gsang sngags nang gtor kun gyi don bsdus dmigs rim zhor la gsal ba'i khyad chos ting 'dzin sngags phyag rgya gyer sgom gyi bsngo lugs bzhi ka tshang ba'o//

oṃ/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka nas// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum me chu rlung gsum gyur// gtor rdzas mi gtsang dri ma bsreg gtor bkrus// gdod nas dag pa skye med stong pa nyid// skye ba'i cho 'phrul raṃ yaṃ kaṃ a las// rlung me thod sgyed steng du ka pā la// phyi dkar nang dmar nyi zla'i rang bzhin snod// yangs shing rgya che'i nang gi phyogs mtshams dbus// dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sha chen lnga// dbugs song drod ma bral ba che zhing tsho// ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me bdud rtsi lnga// drod dang ma bral rlangs pa 'phyur ba'o// de steng 'bru gsum yi ge dkar dmar mthing*// rlung dkyil me g.yos me dkyil drug tu 'bar// thod pa dros nas dam rdzas bcu po zhu// dam tshig bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos bhan+dha khengs// mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams thams cad nas// ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs gnyis med thim// hūm̐ zhu thim pas thugs kyi bdud rtsi sngo// āḥzhu thim pas gsung gi bdud rtsi dmar// oṃ zhu thim pas sku yi bdud rtsi dkar// ha zhes brjod pas kha dog mu tig mdog /hoḥzhes brjod pas dri bzang dpag med 'thul// hrīḥzhes brjod pas ro bcud phun sum tshogs// swā zhes brjod pas dgos 'dod lhun gyis grub// hā zhes brjod pas mgron rnams dgyes pa bskyed// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥswā hā/ bdud rtsi'i rlangs par mchod pa'i lha mo ni// bye ba dung phyur sangs rgyas zhing kun khyab// phyag na rin chen las grub bhan+dha'i skyogs// nyi zla'i tshad tsam bsnams pas bdud rtsi gcus// lha tshogs so so'i mdun du btegs tsam gyis// ljags las 'od zer sbu gus bdud rtsi gsol// mnyes shing tshim nas sku lus bkrag rgyas gyur// de ni dmigs pas bsngo ba'o// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sarba dharma pā la i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

de ni sngags kyis bsngo ba'o// bsdu na des chog /rgyas par spro na badz+ra gu ru sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzña na dhartu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpe gcig nang 'di bzhin 'dug /mchan/ ྃ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi rtsa sngags la i daṃ ba ling+ta khā hi btags/ lag par thal mo sbyar la kha gyen du bstan nas phye la bhan+dha'i dbyibs bya/ khā hi zer ba tsam nas se gol re btab/ de ni phyag rgyas bsngo ba yin/ de nas gyer gyi bsngo ba ni/ hrīḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med// tshe bdag rigs lnga yab yum lha mo lnga/ mgyogs ma bzhi dang sgo ma bzhi la sogs// 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs thams cad kyis// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor ma 'di la dpe gcig nang 'dug /mchan/ bzhes// 'chi med tshe dang nad med bde ba stsol// longs sku thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs// yab yum sras 'khor bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong*// thugs rjes 'gro 'dul lha tshogs thams cad kyis// ye shes bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// 'brel tshad don ldan 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzod// sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas thod phreng lnga// mtshan brgyad 'phrul mtshan bzhi bcu tham pa dang*// o rgyan bye ba phrag brgya la sogs pa'i// pad 'byung zhi ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor ma bzhes// skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// dga' rab shrī seng rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad// rje 'bangs nyer lnga gter ston brgya rtsa brgyad// mtshungs med rā ga as+ya la sogs pa// dbang lung man ngag gang nas brgyud pa yi// rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs thams cad kyis// ye shes bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// byin rlabs 'dzad med chu bo'i rgyun bzhin stsol// dmar nag me phreng yab yum go cha'i lha// drag po rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang*// phrin las lha bzhi khro bcu sgo bar bcas// rig 'dzin khros pa'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor ma bzhes// lus ngag yid gsum bsrung zhing bskyab tu gsol// kun bzang rigs lnga zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis// khrag 'thung rigs drug 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad// sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs kyis// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor ma bzhes/

bar dor rang sar grol bar mdzad du gsol// che mchog dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ni// bdun brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga thams cad kyis// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor ma bzhes// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bla ma dgongs 'dus rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs// rgyud sde bzhi dang theg dgu'i lha tshogs kyis// ye shes bdud rtsi'i ba ling 'di bzhes la// srung skyob tshe dbang mchog gi dngos grub stsol// rdor sems rnam 'joms dkar po gsang ba'i bdag /rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras mchog bzhi// khro bcu yab yum khrag 'thung phur srung sogs// bdud 'dul phur ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor mchod bzhes// bdud dgra dam sri 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod// rdo rje 'jigs byed dug hrul yum dang bcas// dgra nag gshed dmar phyag rgya zil gnon sogs// 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thams cad kyis// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// 'chi bdag gshin rje'i bar chad bzlog par mdzod// khro chu dug gdong las gshin drug dang bcas// king kang dmar nag 'char ka nag gyad chen// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor ma bzhes// byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /dbang chen dmar nag rigs bzhi yum dang bcas// me dbal gnod sbyin lcags sdig bya khyung sogs// pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs thams cad kyis// dam rdzas ba ling mchod pa 'di bzhes la// snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i dngos grub stsol// ye shes mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can// phag khros la sogs ḍā ki bye ba 'bum// ri rab so gnyis rdul mnyam mkha' 'gro dang*// rin chen mkha' 'gro don grub lha lnga rnams// dam tshig rdzas kyi ba ling 'di bzhes la// rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char ba'i phrin las mdzod// ma ning sde lnga srog bdud dpal 'bar ma// yang 'khor brgyad dang bdud dmag bye ba 'bum// mgon chen bzhi bcu rtsa lnga thams cad kyis// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor ma bzhes// phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub par mdzod// re ti mched gsum dud sol dmag zor rgyal// srid pa mo rgyud kun 'dus srung ma'i gtso// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor ma bzhes// phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub par mdzod// seng gdong yab yum bam ro sde brgyad dang*// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum gyi tshogs// ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri phrag rnams// dur bdag mgon dkar ngas nus spyang zhon mched// dam rdzas ba ling mchod pa 'di bzhes la// gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// rnam sras dzam dmar dzam lha ser nag dkar// nor lha pho dgu mo dgu tshogs bdag dang*// lha mo dpal chen ma hā de wa dang*// chos kyi sgron ma tshe ring mched lnga dang*// zhang blon spom ra ār+ya re man+ta// nor lha rgya mtshor gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul// longs spyod char ltar 'bebs pa'i dngos grub stsol// a ti bla med bka' yi bya ra ma// e ka dza ṭi gza' mchog rā hu la// dgra 'dul skyes mchog badz+ra thig le rtsal// bka' srung gsum pos dam rdzas ba ling bzhes// rdzogs chen nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i grogs mdzod cig

/sde dpon sum cu dregs chen bco brgyad dang*// btsan bdud klu mgon spu gri ma ched gsum po// dge bsnyen nyer gcig gdong lha mched gsum dang*// rigs mtshun lha srung rdo rje dgra 'dul rtsal// dmag rgyal spun gsum 'khor bcas gtor ma bzhes// bdag gi las kun 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad dang*// smyo kha mkhar nag thang lha la sogs pa'i// gnas brgyad mtshan brgyad ldan pa'i mthu bo che// sa brgyad sems dpa' chen pos mchod gtor bzhes// rgyal 'gong dam sri'i bar chad bsrung bar mdzod// pad+ma gsung gi bka' srung chen mo dang*// gnod sbyin gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang ni// ye shes grags dang skyes bu lung btsan gnyen/ nor bsnyag la sogs gsang sngags bstan srung rnams// ma hā ba ling+ta yi gtor ma bzhes// rnal 'byor bsam don lhun grub phrin las mdzod// lha srin kun gyi nang nas dam tshig can// mkha' ri lcam dral 'khor bcas gtor mchod bzhes// rab dngos 'bring nyams tha ma rmi lam du// bdag dang o rgyan mjal ba'i mjal kha mdzod// slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i spyan snga ru// 'jig rten bod khams skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// rdo rje g.yu sgron bstan ma'i tshogs dang bcas// dpal mgon bdun cu yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs// dam rdzas dkar gsum brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// bdag gi phrin las kun 'grub mthun rkyen mdzod// hūm̐/ rin chen snod dam rang byung bhan+dha'i snod// rtsa gsum kun 'dus gtor ma rin chen 'bar// log gsum nor bu rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes// zur gsum pho rgyud mo rgyud ma ning mnyes// gtor smad zlum pos 'jig rten mgron kun mnyes// pad 'dab bzhis bskor rigs bzhi ma mo mnyes// kyu gu bzhis mtshan phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub// dkar rtsi dmar rtsi thabs shes 'du 'bral med// mchod pa'i sprin 'phros sangs rgyas zhing kun khyab// dngos 'byor bshams pa'i rten 'brel dam rdzas 'di// rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// phyi snod 'jig rten yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du// nang bcud sems can thams cad gtor mar bshams// ri rab bye ba phrag brgya'i dpal bshos la// nyi zla bye ba phrag brgyas gtor rgyan spras// gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya'i mtheb kyus bskor// lha klu mi yi longs spyod gtor ma'i bcud// snang srid ga

zhir bzhengs rang byung ba ling+ta// bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams lha la 'bul// blang dor med pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang*// bdag dang 'gro kun tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyangs te// khams gsum 'khor ba stong pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi/ zhes a mchod yon tan gyis bskul nas rā ga a s+yes rta lo tha skar zla ba'i snga dro'i thun la smras/ yi ge pa ni shākya'i dge slong pad+ma thabs mkhas kyis bris pa'o// chos skyong grib ma bzhin 'khor bar shog /ces rje karma chags med zhabs kyis mdzad pa la/ gtor mgron dmigs bsal kha shas 'dzud dgos zhes/ gar dbang rin po che mchog gis bka' gnang ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bgyis pa 'gal ba mchis na rtsa gsum lha la bshags shing*/ dge bas 'gro rnams kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig// /
